focus: D1 correctness - runtime/lib graph metadata, integrity gate, description

findingDetails.title: The shipped tree lets the 033-system-speckit-v4 phase folder resolve to error under its own generated-metadata integrity gate
findingDetails.evidence: Executing checkGeneratedMetadataIntegrity plus resolveGeneratedMetadataIntegrity with the orchestrator's defaults (grandfather false, status gate false) returns status error, detail SOURCE_FINGERPRINT_MISMATCH; the same call on specs/system-deep-loop/z_archive/010-deep-context-gathering returns error. The rule is pushed unconditionally (orchestrator.ts:1068), grandfather defaults false (capability-flags.ts:97-98), and checker source plus dist are byte-identical at v4.0.0.3 and HEAD, so a strict run over that folder prints FAILED on the tagged tree. The folder docs and metadata are tag-identical; the range changed only graph-metadata.json (01162dfe43) without a re-derive. The digest write and the last spec.md edit are the same pre-range commit (06b231a8db), so this is carried pre-existing debt, not a range-introduced change; CI tolerates it via base comparison (changed-packet-validation.yml:89-145). A 279-packet sweep found 10 violation folders, of which 7 resolve to info. Root cause INFERRED: a projection change without a docset bump, or a pre-range doc-set change without a re-derive.
findingDetails.recommendation: Re-derive the folder's graph metadata (the fan-out's own generate-description/backfill pair is the known repair path) and add the repair to the release tail; if a re-derive of an untouched folder cannot reproduce the stored digest, treat that as the tooling signal it is.
findingDetails.scopeProof: Ran the repo's own checker and resolver on the folders, compared metadata and checker blobs across the tag, read the rule wiring and flag defaults, and swept 279 packets to size the class.
